items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I went with Charlie. And I told Pettiford to come down to the theatre, and he came down and played, and Charlie hired him right away

ctx.x: In '42, I think. Yeah, I think it was at that time. But then, I really traveled after that...with Barnet, I mean. I went back with Kirk, because Charlie said he was going to take off six months -- he didn't want to play no more for a while. And after he was off a month, he called me up... I was with Andy, and he called me up telling me he got a contract on me; and I didn't remember signing no contract with him.
Well, how long had you been with Barnet when he decided to lay off for a while?
